passages.text: Commercial and Brand Partners For companies and brands interested in working together on marketing and performance-based collaborations, email us at partnerships@lovevery.com

Education, Healthcare, and Childcare Professional Programs For verified schools, libraries, doctor or therapy practices, and daycare/preschool programs interested in wholesale orders or marketing collaborations, email us as education@lovevery.com

The Collab Program Supports Partnerships Across Markets Lovevery invites creators and social partners to apply to its Collab Program, which provides approved participants with access to campaigns, branded assets, and performance tracking. It has separate partnership routes for businesses and for education, healthcare, and childcare professionals. The work also extends beyond the US. When Senior Influencer Marketing Specialist Kylie McGinniss announced her Amsterdam role, she described building on influencer partnerships across the EU, UK, and APAC. Her post indicates the regional scope of the team’s work, without disclosing campaign performance.

passages.text: A creator known for early literacy can introduce the brand to parents who never shopped for its infant kits. Lovevery has also widened the ways families can buy. Retail placement makes products available for physical discovery and product gifting. Its Pre-Loved marketplace, launched in 2025, gives secondhand buyers an official route into a market where families were already trading used Lovevery toys. It can serve parents interested in the brand who prefer a lower-priced first purchase. These options connect audience growth to commerce without requiring every interested parent to begin with a Play Kits subscription.

passages.text: Our story CEO Jessica Rolph with her family Lovevery Founder Rod Morris with family The creation of Lovevery (pronounced "Love-every") began with Jessica, Rod, and an idea. Jessica: Passionate about giving babies the best and healthiest beginning in life. As founding partner, she helped to build Happy Family into a top organic baby food company. Confident that she was giving her babies the best nutrition, she started to become curious about what each of her three children’s brains were craving. Rod: A builder of companies and movements with environmental and social impact. He was masterful at making things happen and generating results.
Rachel Coley Rachel is a licensed Occupational Therapist and creator of CanDo Kiddo. Her expertise is infant and toddler development and her passion is supporting families.

Dennis and Nancy Dunn Dennis and Nancy are the creators of the Growing Child. The Dunns engaged child development experts from across the country to write their series of science-based development publications covering the first six years of growth.
